excluded.reason: Podman's original 10.88.0.0/16 bridge overlapped kiln0, so the network path was not functional.
22 invocations timed out at 120 seconds; do not compare its reported throughput.
One level-16 invocation failed when concurrent namespace teardown removed a reused veth between EEXIST and stale-link deletion.
The completed attempt's manifest recorded a dirty worktree, so it was excluded to keep published workload sessions clean.

boundaries: The 100 ms latency confidence intervals apply to paired session ratios, not absolute cold-start latency.
The idle-gap sweep, concurrency and memory campaign each use one VM boot.
Workload confidence intervals use only three boots and are coarse.
DNS and HTTP include public network and resolver variance.
The workload session label is an ordinal within each workload; compare manifest boot IDs across workload directories.
runsc is a stronger-isolation tier; Firecracker and Kata were unavailable without /dev/kvm.
